title: DATA↔BACK-INGEST-001: Telemetry Ingest Routing + Schema Validation
description: Backend routes broker telemetry to the ingest point; Data validates schema-conformance at the ingest boundary and owns ingest→storage. Includes Segment A of the joint Telemetry-Integrity SLO. Grounded in DATA_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.1 (Backend/Cloud Engineer) and BACKEND_CLOUD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.4 (Data Engineer). Canonical ordering puts DATA before BACK.

broker_endpoint.description: MQTT broker endpoint Backend exposes to the ingest pipeline.

qos.description: MQTT QoS level for the routed stream.

schema_version.description: Telemetry schema version validated at ingest.

schema_validation.description: Data-side schema-conformance check at the ingest boundary.

result.description: Conformance result; QUARANTINE = held for review.

rejected_reason.description: Reason when result != PASS (e.g., unknown schema_version, type mismatch).

segment_a_slo.description: BACK-owned SLO: broker → ingest routing point.

delivery_target_pct.description: ≥ 99.9% of broker messages delivered to the routing point.

measured_pct.description: Measured delivery percentage in the review window.

handoff_counters.description: Routing-point instrumentation; counter mismatch alerts both roles within 5 minutes.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine ingest-boundary interpretation (agent-autonomous). SLO breaches trigger a joint RCA within 2 business days; topic/routing changes that break consumers escalate to a CCR + Tier-2 ADR.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (ingest-contract alignment at planning); CONTINUOUS (SLO measured continuously, reviewed monthly); SLA_FROM_EVENT (counter-mismatch alert within 5 minutes)
confirm_conditions: schema_version resolves in the telemetry schema registry and schema_validation.result = PASS
qos is 0/1/2 and topic_structure matches the agreed hierarchy
reject_conditions: unknown schema_version or schema_validation.result = FAIL without a rejected_reason
topic_structure changed without a CCR (breaks routing)
measured_pct < 99.9 asserted as acceptable without a joint RCA
counter_conditions: result = QUARANTINE — request schema clarification before commit
counter mismatch detected — request reconciliation before declaring the segment healthy
